desc: A rare storm cloud spirit, floating cumulus body of pale lavender cloud with two cloud arms, angry gold eyes, small teal lightning bolts under it. Not an animal. High quality 16-bit pixel art game pet, crisp pixels, right-facing 3/4 view, full body with empty margin, dark violet outline, pixel cluster shading with clear light and shadow, palette of lavender, pale violet, cream, ivory and deep navy, no background.
